statement: Training induces useful compressibility at equal quality

controls: dense, ordinary lowrank, simple packed quantization where applicable
reason: See paired main-training table: compressibility and equal-quality are reported separately; common recipe, bounded tuning, and plateau/continuation coverage limit generalization
